name: bundle-curator
description: Harness-agnostic curation tooling for Zettelkasten-style OKF wiki bundles: skills, shared agents, and scripts to onboard sources, dispatch domain curators, review charters, and drain scoring/landscape backlogs. Domain-agnostic — reads domain slugs from the consuming repo's okf-core.toml. Mastered directly in this repo (not vendored from Cloudsmith).
